strategy.name: Order Flow Footprint & CVD
strategy.summary: Look for absorption (price vs CVD divergence) and stacked imbalances; no delta signal means no trade.

rules.text: Bullish absorption: price lower low while CVD higher low (or equal low with sharp CVD drop), then a positive-delta candle closes above the footprint POC.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was there absorption and a positive-delta close above the POC?

rules.text: Stacked imbalance: 3+ consecutive levels with ≥ 300% diagonal imbalance.
Stop 3–5 ticks beyond the absorption level.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was the stop 3–5 ticks beyond absorption?

rules.text: No delta spike or CVD divergence → no trade.
rules.checklistQuestion: Was there a delta spike or CVD divergence?
